integrity: The proof is supplied with exact finite-count and rational-identity checks. Historical comparisons include inspected primary literature and specific remaining risks; the result has not undergone an independent scientific assessment.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic law applies only to simple symmetric bridges whose number of returns has a fixed positive density strictly below one; integer-height lattice oscillations preclude an unrestricted continuous centered Gumbel limit. Finite enumerations do not certify asymptotic claims, and historical priority is not independently established.
title: A lattice Poisson law for the height of bridges with linearly many returns
